tauri_command:get_db_uri.note: Conductor's shell command for its database file; our UI opens `conducted.db` with `db_open` (D137).

tauri_command:configure_http_proxy.note: Points Conductor's native HTTP at the proxy in its Internal setting internal_tauri_http_proxy_url (main @2022870). Internal settings are staff tools, which stay out.

tauri_command:is_cef_runtime.note: Conductor's check for its CEF runtime; our app always uses the system WebKit view.

tauri_command:native_http_fetch_cancel.note: Cancels a native HTTP request. Ours is http_cancel. The run cuts the network off; ours is shown by http.rs plat_30_fetch_returns_the_status_headers_and_body (ours allows only its listed hosts).

tauri_command:native_http_fetch.note: An HTTP request from the native side. Ours is http_fetch. The run cuts the network off; ours is shown by http.rs plat_30_fetch_returns_the_status_headers_and_body (ours allows only its listed hosts).

tauri_command:native_http_upload_cancel.note: Cancels an upload to Conductor's own server (main @2025953; the caller is the Roundhouse profile photo upload, renderApp @11079548). Conductor's service stays out.

tauri_command:native_http_upload_file.note: Uploads a file to Conductor's own server: its one caller sends a profile photo to Roundhouse (renderApp @11079548). Conductor's service stays out.

tauri_command:materialize_local_path_att.note: Copies a dropped file into the attachment store. Ours is attachment_materialize. No catalogue state drops a file on Conductor's composer; ours is shown by attachments.rs plat_20_materialize_copies_a_dropped_file_into_the_draft_folder.

tauri_command:list_file_tree.note: Lists a workspace's files. Ours is search_list_tree. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 87 calls through search_list_tree in 86 states.

tauri_command:list_workspace_artifacts.note: Pages through a workspace's .context folder for the Artifacts tab. Ours is search_list_artifacts. Ours is shown by file_search.rs rev_10_list_artifacts_pages_through_the_context_folder.

tauri_command:fuzzy_filter_files.note: Filters a workspace's files by a fuzzy query. Ours is search_fuzzy, and search_list_tree for an empty query. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 87 calls through search_list_tree in 86 states.

tauri_command:grep_workspace.note: Searches file contents in a workspace. Ours is search_grep. Ours is shown by file_search.rs plat_06_grep_reports_line_column_and_preview.

tauri_command:rpc_to_sidecar.note: Sends one JSON-RPC line to the sidecar. Ours is sidecar_send. Stage 2 carries every sidecar line of Conductor's frontend through it to our sidecar_send (translator.ts tunnel), which getHarnessVersions and the other sidecar calls above answered through.

tauri_command:send_native_notification.note: Shows a macOS notification. Ours is notify. The run's host refuses notifications (live-server.ts); ours is notify in notifications.rs.

tauri_command:pty_ack_bytes.note: Acknowledges terminal output bytes for flow control. Ours is pty_ack. No catalogue state runs a terminal in Conductor's frontend; ours is shown by pty.rs plat_07_flow_control_pauses_at_high_water_and_wakes_below_low.

tauri_command:pty_write_mirror.note: CLOUD-09's finish chose a JS text mirror for a cloud terminal rather than Conductor's headless PTY copy; no Rust mirror commands are built.

tauri_command:pty_persist_terminal_histo.note: Conductor's UI asks Rust to save a terminal's scrollback. Ours saves it in Rust when the terminal's process ends (pty.rs exit watcher, terminal_history.rs), so there is no command.

tauri_command:pty_create_mirror.note: CLOUD-09's finish chose a JS text mirror for a cloud terminal rather than Conductor's headless PTY copy; no Rust mirror commands are built.

tauri_command:pty_resize_mirror.note: CLOUD-09's finish chose a JS text mirror for a cloud terminal rather than Conductor's headless PTY copy; no Rust mirror commands are built.

tauri_command:pty_delete_mirror.note: CLOUD-09's finish chose a JS text mirror for a cloud terminal rather than Conductor's headless PTY copy; no Rust mirror commands are built.

tauri_command:raw_websocket_send_text.note: Sends on the WebSocket to Conductor's own server (main @2941513). Our cloud relay is cloud_relay_send to the user's Worker (D018).

tauri_command:raw_websocket_ping.note: Pings the WebSocket to Conductor's own server (main @2941513). Our cloud relay to the user's Worker is D018's.

tauri_command:raw_websocket_close.note: Closes the WebSocket to Conductor's own server (main @2941513). Our cloud relay is cloud_relay_close (D018).

tauri_command:raw_websocket_open.note: Opens the native WebSocket Conductor's client keeps to its own server's /ws route, signed in with the Conductor account's API token (main @1856019, @2941513). Our cloud relay is cloud_relay_open to the user's Worker (D018).

tauri_command:get_user_shell.note: The user's login shell. Ours is shell_login_env. native-and-sidecar-map A2 found no such command in Conductor's own binary, so its UI falls back to /bin/zsh; ours answers. The run never asked it; ours is shown by shell.rs plat_04_capture_uses_per_shell_flags_and_a_delimiter.

tauri_command:pty_load_terminal_history.note: Loads a terminal's saved scrollback. Ours is pty_load_history. No catalogue state restores a terminal in Conductor's frontend; ours is shown by terminal_history.rs plat_08_saved_history_reads_back_byte_for_byte.

tauri_command:set_remote_file_sync_foreg.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_command:start_remote_file_sync.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_command:resolve_remote_file_sync_d.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_command:reject_remote_file_sync_di.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_command:trigger_remote_file_sync.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_command:cleanup_remote_file_sync.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_command:stop_remote_file_sync.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_command:get_path_env.note: The login shell's PATH. Ours is shell_login_env. native-and-sidecar-map A2 found no such command in Conductor's own binary, so its UI falls back; ours answers. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through shell_login_env in 119 states.

tauri_command:set_posthog_user_context.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:start_on_device_speech.note: Starts on-device dictation. Ours is speech_start. Ours is shown by speech.rs plat_12_availability_is_checked_on_every_call and the other PLAT-12 tests.

tauri_command:get_deepgram_api_key.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:stop_on_device_speech.note: Ends dictation and returns the text. Ours is speech_stop. Ours is shown by speech.rs plat_12_availability_is_checked_on_every_call and the other PLAT-12 tests.

tauri_command:cancel_on_device_speech.note: Cancels dictation. Ours is speech_cancel. Ours is shown by speech.rs plat_12_availability_is_checked_on_every_call and the other PLAT-12 tests.

tauri_command:on_device_speech_available.note: Whether on-device dictation can run. Ours is speech_available. native-and-sidecar-map A2 found no such command in Conductor's own binary, so its UI falls back to unavailable. Ours is shown by speech.rs plat_12_availability_is_checked_on_every_call and the other PLAT-12 tests.

tauri_command:get_agent_binary_state.note: The agent programs' download state. Ours is programs_state. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through programs_state in 119 states.

tauri_command:request_agent_binary_downl.note: Downloads an agent program. Ours is program_install. No catalogue state starts a download; ours is shown by binaries.rs plat_28_a_second_install_of_the_same_program_is_joined.

tauri_command:execute_shell_command_canc.note: Starts a shell command that cancel_shell_command can stop by id, and returns its output. Ours is shell_start with the id, ending in shell://done. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 939 calls through shell_start in 119 states.

tauri_command:cancel_shell_command.note: Kills a cancellable shell command's whole process group by its id. Ours is shell_cancel (shell.rs terminate_group). The run never cancels one (Conductor cancels only after its own timeout); ours is shown by shell.rs plat_03_finish_run_carries_the_cancel_to_the_done_payload.

tauri_command:execute_shell_command.note: Runs a shell command and returns its output. Ours is shell_run. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 10967 calls through shell_run in 119 states.

tauri_command:ensure_app_logger_started.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:get_app_logger_connection.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:configure_app_logger_persi.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:configure_sentry_external_.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:configure_app_logger_exter.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:configure_verbose_logging.note: Switches the Rust log level at run time. Ours is log_set_level. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through log_set_level in 119 states.

tauri_command:configure_sidecar_internal.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:configure_sidecar_inspect.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:write_file_async.note: Writes a file without blocking the UI. Ours is fs_write_text_atomic, which runs off the main thread. Ours is shown by files.rs plat_05_write_text_atomic_keeps_old_content_when_rename_fails.

tauri_command:resolve_port_forward_token.note: D110: the pairing token stays in Rust, so the token round trip and this command are not built.

tauri_command:reject_port_forward_token.note: D110: the pairing token stays in Rust, so the token round trip and this command are not built.

tauri_command:get_or_create_local_storag.note: Hands Conductor's UI the Keychain key it encrypts local entries with. D087: ours keeps that key inside Rust, which encrypts the saved scrollback itself, so the key never reaches the UI.

tauri_command:get_keychain_setting.note: Reads a Keychain item. Ours is keychain_get. The run's host refuses the Keychain (live-server.ts); ours is shown by keychain.rs plat_10_set_get_and_delete_round_trip.

tauri_command:set_keychain_setting.note: Writes a Keychain item. Ours is keychain_set. The run's host refuses the Keychain (live-server.ts); ours is shown by keychain.rs plat_10_set_get_and_delete_round_trip.

tauri_command:delete_keychain_setting.note: Deletes a Keychain item. Ours is keychain_delete. The run's host refuses the Keychain (live-server.ts); ours is shown by keychain.rs plat_10_set_get_and_delete_round_trip.

tauri_command:submit_app_logs.note: Sends the UI's log records to the Rust logger, which writes the app's log files. Ours is log_write, one record per call. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 5671 calls through log_write in 119 states.

tauri_command:fuzzy_match_files.note: Ranks files for a fuzzy query. Ours is search_fuzzy. Ours is shown by file_search.rs plat_06_fuzzy_filter_files_keeps_only_matching_files.

tauri_command:get_file_metadata.note: A file's size and kind. Ours is fs_stat. Ours is shown by files.rs plat_05_stat_reports_size_symlink_and_time.

tauri_command:update_window_vibrancy.note: Turns the window's vibrancy on or off. Ours is window_set_vibrancy. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through window_set_vibrancy in 119 states.

tauri_command:open_devtools.note: Opens the web inspector from the Help menu. Ours is window_toggle_inspector. No catalogue state opens the Help menu's inspector; ours is driven by app/command-handlers.test.ts.

tauri_command:get_binary_verification_er.note: Agent programs that failed verification. Ours is programs_verification_errors. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through programs_verification_errors in 119 states.

tauri_command:write_encoded_image_to_cli.note: Puts an image on the clipboard. Ours uses the clipboard plugin's writeImage (platform/tauri.ts decodes the bytes to RGBA first). The run's host refuses the clipboard (live-server.ts); ours is writeClipboardImage in platform/tauri.ts.

tauri_command:sync_agent_path_overrides.note: Mirrors a user-chosen agent program into the overrides folder. Ours is programs_sync_path_overrides. No catalogue state chooses a program in Conductor's settings; system.set-13.test.ts shows our app calling it when a path changes.

tauri_command:native_http_download_file.note: Downloads a file from the native side with progress. Ours is http_download. The run cuts the network off; ours is shown by http.rs plat_30_fetch_returns_the_status_headers_and_body (ours allows only its listed hosts).

tauri_command:get_resource_usage.note: CPU and memory per process, by workspace. Ours is resource_usage. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through resource_usage in 119 states.

tauri_command:export_app_logs.note: Exports the app's logs to a file. Ours is logs_export. No catalogue state exports logs; ours is shown by logger.rs plat_18_an_export_contains_the_redacted_record_and_the_sidecar_log.

tauri_command:prefetch_agent_binaries_fr.note: Downloads the agent programs an update will need before it installs. Ours is programs_prefetch. No catalogue state installs an update; ours is shown by binaries.rs plat_28_prefetch_installs_only_the_programs_that_are_not_ready.

tauri_command:get_installed_manual_updat.note: The update that was just installed, for its release notes. Ours is updater_installed_update. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through updater_installed_update in 119 states.

tauri_command:check_for_updates.note: Checks for a new app version from the Help menu. Ours is updater_check. The run cuts the network off; ours is shown by updater.rs plat_13_a_newer_signed_version_in_the_feed_is_an_update.

tauri_command:check_codex_auth.note: Codex's sign-in state. Ours reads it from the sidecar's agent detection (getAgentInstalls), not a Rust command. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through sidecar:getAgentInstalls in 119 states.

tauri_command:get_openai_api_key_from_en.note: native-and-sidecar-map A2 found no such command in Conductor's own binary: the UI's call fails into its catch (renderApp @10917045). Ours reads the key from the login shell only when the user picks "Use the key from this Mac" (D033).

tauri_command:get_anthropic_api_key_from.note: native-and-sidecar-map A2 found no such command in Conductor's own binary: the UI's call fails into its catch (renderApp @10917045). Ours reads the key from the login shell only when the user picks "Use the key from this Mac" (D033).

tauri_command:check_full_disk_access.note: Whether the app has Full Disk Access. Ours is full_disk_access_check. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 12 calls through full_disk_access_check in 12 states.

tauri_command:set_agent_binary_failure_i.note: A staff test hook on Conductor's Internal page that makes the next downloads fail (renderApp @11204939, "Inject failures"). Staff tools and test hooks stay out.

tauri_command:remove_agent_binary.note: Removes a downloaded agent program. Ours is program_remove. No catalogue state presses Remove; ours is program_remove in binaries.rs, beside plat_28_install_writes_metadata_points_the_shim_and_prunes_the_old_version.

tauri_command:redownload_agent_binary.note: Downloads an agent program again. Ours is program_redownload. No catalogue state presses Redownload; ours is program_redownload in binaries.rs, beside plat_28_install_writes_metadata_points_the_shim_and_prunes_the_old_version.

tauri_command:check_sidecar_http_health.note: Asks the sidecar's HTTP health route. D028: our sidecar has no HTTP server and no health route.

tauri_command:crash_rust.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:get_sidecar_log_path.note: The sidecar's log file path. Ours is sidecar_log_path. Ours is driven by platform/tauri-sidecar.test.ts.

tauri_command:update_traffic_light_posit.note: Moves the window's traffic-light buttons. Ours is window_set_traffic_lights. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through window_set_traffic_lights in 119 states.

tauri_command:take_pending_notification_.note: Notification clicks queued during a cold start. Ours is notification_take_pending. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through notification_take_pending in 119 states.

tauri_command:quit_app.note: Quits the app after asking the UI. Ours is app_quit. The run's host refuses quitting (live-server.ts); ours is driven by platform/tauri-platform.test.ts.

tauri_command:get_db_version_warning.note: Reports a database newer than the app. Ours is db_version_check. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through db_version_check in 119 states.

tauri_command:is_running_under_rosetta.note: Whether the build runs under Rosetta. Ours reads it from system_info's machine and build architectures. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through system_info in 119 states.

tauri_command:poll_app_action.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:submit_app_action_result.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:ensure_app_actions_started.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

tauri_command:ensure_sidecar_started.note: Starts the sidecar if it is not running. Ours is sidecar_ensure_started. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), our backend answered 120 calls through ours in 119 states.
